prompt.content:
Generate one complete Java JUnit 5 test class for the given focal public method.
Output only one fenced java code block. Write at most TWO short test methods.
Import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test and use the exact annotation @Test.
Import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*.
Use java.io.ByteArrayInputStream as the underlying stream. Do not use Mockito,
reflection, custom InputStream subclasses, or private fields. Use only public APIs.
Use explicit expected values, read counts and byte arrays as assertions.
Include every necessary import and a valid package org.apache.tika.io declaration.
Every test that uses streams must declare throws Exception.
Name the public class LookaheadInputStreamGeneratedTest. Finish the complete class.
